ui.name: Idaho Department of Labor, Unemployment Insurance Tax

efile.text: Idaho requires you to file W-2s and Form 967 electronically if you're an employer who meets the IRS requirements to file W-2s electronically and you have 10 or more employees in Idaho.

returns.name: Form 910, Idaho Withholding Payment/Return
contents: Filed for every period of the assigned cycle, with a 'zero' form if nothing was withheld, online in TAP or by paper (not both); due dates by cycle are in the profile's deposit rules.

returns.name: Form 967, Annual Idaho Withholding Reconciliation, with W-2s
contents: Filed once a year to reconcile the withholding account whatever the Form 910 cycle; due the last day of January with the W-2s; Form 1099s are due the last day of February (Form 96 annual information return the last day of February).
Idaho requires W-2s and Form 967 electronically if the employer must file W-2s electronically for the IRS and has 10 or more employees in Idaho.

notModelled: The 12-month $300,000 test, the one-pay-period rule and the farmer rules for assigning a cycle.
Forms 1099 and the Form 96 information return (the last day of February).

deposits.interpretation: Idaho assigns each withholding account a filing cycle effective for a full calendar year (a change request must arrive by November 15): SEMIMONTHLY if it withholds at least $25,000 a month or at least $300,000 in a 12-month period; MONTHLY if it withholds less than $25,000 a month and more than $750 a quarter, or has only one monthly pay period; QUARTERLY if it withholds $750 or less each quarter (or is a farmer who must file with the Department of Labor); ANNUAL if it withholds less than $750 a year (or is a farmer not required to file with the Department of Labor). Form 910 is due: monthly, the 20th of the month after the period; semimonthly, the 20th of the month for the 1st-15th and the 5th of the following month for the 16th-end; quarterly, the last day of the month after the quarter; annual, the last day of January. A zero payment form is required when nothing was withheld; a due date on a weekend or state holiday moves to the next business day. Tax is due by when wages were PAID. The frequency is an INPUT (the cycle assigned) or is derived from an average MONTHLY amount supplied using only the $25,000 and $250-a-month ($750 a quarter) levels; the 12-month $300,000 test, the one-pay-period rule, the farmer rules and the annual criteria are inputs.

enrollment: Register for an Idaho withholding account (steps not read) and use TAP.
To produce substitute withholding forms from software, follow the Commission's Substitute Forms Specifications and contact its Substitute Forms Help Desk for approval.

returns.name: Quarterly unemployment tax report and payment (Forms TX20, TX26)
contents: Reports and payments are due the last day of April, July, October and January for the quarter ended the preceding month; there is no grace period.
When the last day falls on a weekend or holiday the next business day is the due date (Idaho Code 72-1349).
